dataset.title: Dataset
dataset.description: Name of the dataset to which the document belongs.

classified.title: Classified
classified.description: Whether the document has been classified.

classIds.title: Class IDs
classIds.description: List of class IDs assigned to the document. If classified is False, this will be None.

originalFileExtension.title: Original File Extension
originalFileExtension.description: extension of the originally uploaded file, before any conversion (e.g. html, docx). none if no conversion occurred.

fileSizeMb.title: File Size
fileSizeMb.description: Size of the stored document file in MB.

result.title: Analysis Result
result.description: Result of the document analysis if completed.

numPages.title: Number of Pages
numPages.description: Number of pages in the document.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Metadata associated with the document. This is a user-defined dictionary that can have any properties.

status.title: Processing Status
status.description: Current status of the document processing (deprecated, will be removed in future versions).

parentDocumentId.title: Parent Document ID
parentDocumentId.description: Unique identifier of the parent document, if this document was created by splitting another document.

parentDocumentPages.title: Parent Document Pages
parentDocumentPages.description: List of page numbers from the parent document that make up this document (zero indexed).

transformedData.title: Transformed Data
transformedData.description: Output of the transformation chain applied to this structured document (csv, xlsx, xls, json or xml), if any. Returned when fetching a single document; null in document lists.

transformationReceipt.title: Transformation Receipt
transformationReceipt.description: Hashes identifying the input, code, context and output of the applied transformation chain.

sections.title: Sections
sections.description: A list of parsed sections in the page.

text.title: Text
text.description: The text content of the page - a concatenation of the text in all sections.

pageNum.title: Page Number
pageNum.description: The number of this page in document (zero indexed).

pages.title: Pages
pages.description: A list of parsed pages in the document.

numPages.title: Number of Pages
numPages.description: The number of pages in the document.

text.title: Text
text.description: The text content of the document.

language.title: Language
language.description: The dominant language of the document.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of the section (text, table, image)

text.title: Text
text.description: The text content of the section

bbox.title: Bounding Box
bbox.description: Bounding box of the section in the format [x1, y1, x2, y2], in percentage units [0, 1] within the page

header.title: Header Type
header.description: For text sections, the type of header: paragraph (default), h1 - h6

tableList.title: Table List
tableList.description: For table sections, a list of lists representing the table. The outer list represents rows, the inner lists represent column values in those rows. The first row is the header.If there is no header, the first row is a list of empty strings.
